name: Roommates with Benefits
source:
As a college transfer student, your mission is simple: Get in, get educated, get out. But will that plan change when you meet the ultimate partier?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Roommates_with_Benefits]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
身为一名大学转校生，你的目标再简单不过：入学、拿文凭、走人。但当你遇上那位派对狂人后，这份计划是否会就此打乱？

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Roommates_with_Benefits]Choices Wikia[/url]]
